page.layout: Running head at top: page number "64" at left, title "NOTÆ." at centre. Main text in one column on the right. Left margin holds two notes: a starred note at the level of "Fuisse illi" and an italic note "Abul Feda." beside the following lines. Three numbered entries (47, 48, 49) at the foot of the column.

main_text.l: tes. Abraham sc. istum Tamani sub أصحمة[?] Asʿhama
Alnajashi, seu Æthiopum rege, præfectum in urbe
Sanaa Ecclesiam struxisse, ad quem, neglectui habitâ
Caabâ, peregrinationes ab hominibus institui voluit.
eam cùm Arabs quidam conspurcâssent, & indignè trac-
tâssent ad iram provocatum Abraham sc ad diruen-
dam Caabam juramento obstrinxisse, atque ejus rei
gratiâ collectis copiis Meccham rectâ retendisse. Fuisse
illi {*}Elephantem nomine محمود[?] Mahmud, qui
cum jam Meccæ propinquus faciem Caabæ adver-
tere cogeretur in genua procumbens progredi recusa-
bat; cùm alio alacriter pergebat. Misisse autem De-
um avium greges quæ singulæ ternos gestabant lapil-
los, ore unum, pedibus reliquos, magnitudine inter
lenticulam & cicerem, ejus tamen ponderis, ut cùm
in hominem galeâ obtectum decidèrent, perforatis
galeâ & homine (addunt Jallalani, & Elephanto) in
terram caderent. iis inscripta fuisse perdendorum
nomina. Vide AlCeshaph[?], AlBidawium, Jallalani,
qui Commentarios in Alc. scripserunt: & histori-
cos Abul Fedam, AlJannabium, Ahmedem, &c.
contigisse hoc tradunt anno Anusherwani 42, quo & natus
est Mohammedes.
47 تكسوم[?] Tacsum, Abraha filius.
48 مسروق[?] Masruk, Abrahæ filius, qui ultimus
Æthiopum Tamano imperavit, reverso ad Hamyare-
nsis regno. Æthiopum autem imperium annos 72.
circiter durâsse refert Allannabius; regnante Aryato,
20. Abrahah, 50 circiter. Tacsumo, duos.
49 سيف بن ذي يزن[?] Saif Ebn Di Yazan,
Hamyarensis, [?] qui imperavit ab Anusherwano rege
Persarum, (quas frustra prius ab Heraclio Imperatore
petierat)

page.notes: Arabic words are transcribed from the scan and marked [?] where the letters are not clearly legible. "Ceshaph" in "AlCeshaph" and the reading of the star note's last word ("plu-rēt") are doubtful. In entry 49 the comma after "Hamyarensis" and the word "qui" are partly obscured by a stain. The "Abul Feda." note is placed beside the lines it appears to accompany; its exact position is approximate. The scan is cut off at the right edge of the column, so the last word of entry 49 may be incomplete.
